import importlib.metadata
import bench_map_compat as montage_compat
from MontagePy import main as MontageMain
montage_module=pathlib.Path(MontageMain.__file__)
montage_compat._find_montage_binary=lambda name: montage_module if name=="mProject" else None
def montagepy_project(unused_binary,input_path,output_path,template_path):
 result=MontageMain.mProject(str(input_path),str(output_path),str(template_path),energyMode=False)
 if str(result.get("status"))=="0": return True
 if "No overlap" in str(result.get("msg","")): return False
 raise RuntimeError("MontagePy mProject: "+json.dumps(result))
montage_compat._project_with_montage=montagepy_project
montage_implementation={"backend":"official MontagePy mProject", "version":importlib.metadata.version("MontagePy"),"module":str(montage_module),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(montage_module.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"energyMode":False,"source_built_cli_status":"SIGSEGV; explicitly separate implementation"}

script=source/"benchmarks/bench_map_smacs0723_stackers.py"
sys.argv=[str(script),*arguments]
try: runpy.run_path(str(script),run_name="__main__")
except SystemExit as error:
 if error.code not in (None,0): raise
path=pathlib.Path(arguments[arguments.index("--json-out")+1]); report=json.loads(path.read_text())
report["montage_implementation"]=montage_implementation
for row in report["rows"]:
 row["benchmark_method_id"]=row["name"]; row["name"]="montagepy_mproject"
 for key in ("product_path","product_weight_path"):
  if key in row:
   original=pathlib.Path(row[key]); target=original.with_name(original.name.replace("montage_tan","montagepy_mproject"))
   original.rename(target); row[key]=str(target)
path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
markdown=pathlib.Path(arguments[arguments.index("--markdown-out")+1])
markdown.write_text(markdown.read_text().replace("montage_tan","montagepy_mproject"))
',*sys.argv[1:]])

hypothesis: Official MontagePy general mProject on the common six-band raw-aligned cohort; score injection response, flux, effective PSF, artifacts and discovery against the existing matched SWarp products
notes: Historical six-band raw-aligned PATT_NUM train cohort (1,2,4,5,7); this is not the calibrated 128-pixel INR cohort.
This is a method/product comparison only. Keep depth_claim false until the products are scored under a frozen detection, effective-response, and uncertainty contract.

The validation-000 stack run retains the full 28-source injection manifest; a derived brightest-only manifest selects all sources at the minimum reference_ab_magnitude using score_field_models._measure_effective_psfs semantics, including band_flux_jy.
The explicit Torchsky and official Drizzle candidates are the available square methods at pixfrac=1.0; the standard method menu has no pf0.8/pf0.6 IDs, so those variants are not claimed here.
Reference image is now the six-band published-map job's common-grid iter0 product. The sky target and injection manifests are unchanged; crop x0=0 indexes the mapped reference, not detector frames.
source_kind: real JWST SMACS0723 aligned native detector exposures with historical injection batches; five selected PATT_NUM train patterns
